title: The Scholarship of the quarry
author: P. M. Villalobos
blurb: Theo Ravensworth, the new kid at a school built over something old, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. But when the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must decide who to be when the labels come off, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
